description: This file defines an interface class IOmiProxy in the omi namespace, which provides methods for mounting and unmounting crypted bundles, as well as registering and unregistering error listeners. It serves as a wrapper around an omi_dbus_api, simplifying method calls and signal handling.

classes.name: IOmiProxy
classes.description: Interface class for managing crypted bundles and error listeners related to omi_dbus_api interactions.

methods.name: mountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Mounts a crypted bundle given container ID, filesystem image path, and config path; outputs decrypted config JSON path.

methods.name: umountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Unmounts a crypted bundle by container ID.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers an error listener callback and returns a listener ID.

methods.name: unregisterListener
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered error listener using its ID.

ctags.name: OmiErrorListener
ctags.pattern: /^    typedef std::function<void(const std::string&, ErrorType, const void*)> OmiErrorListener;$/
